C1793.title: Zendesk Acquisition Exposes Customer Data Integration Risks in Service Desk SaaS
C1793.summary: In June 2022, Zendesk announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by an investor group for 10.2 billion US dollars. As a customer service SaaS platform, Zendesk ticketing and support systems process large volumes of customer communication and business data. If this acquisition is used as a customer data integration risk case, sources on Zendesk business nature, customer data processing scope, or M&A data migration risk should be added rather than inferring leakage risk solely from the acquisition event.
